apiChanges: Workspace list: page size capped at 100, version lookup scoped to the page

`GET /workspaces/workspacesList` now caps `limit` at 100 (minimum 1, default; 10) and treats an invalid or < 1 `page` as 1. The response's `pagination.limit`; reports the capped value. The active-version lookup now reads only the page's; workspaces and only `{ workspaceId, version }`, instead of the full active-version; record of every workspace in the tenant. `getAllActiveVersions(workspaceIds)` keeps; its old behaviour when called without ids; `findLatestActiveByFilter` takes an; optional projection. Also fixed: with `limit=1` and a pinned workspace, page 1; ran `.limit(0)`, which Mongo treats as "no limit", so it returned every workspace.; That query is now skipped.
configChanges: Vault secret names for AI builder / LLM gateway switched to kebab-case

`runtime-bootstrap.js` now resolves `AI_BUILDER_BASE_URL`, `AI_BUILDER_USERNAME`,; `AI_BUILDER_PASSWORD`, `AI_BUILDER_HIERARCHY`, `LLM_GATEWAY_URL` and `LLM_GATEWAY_API_KEY` from the; vault secrets `ai-builder-base-url`, `ai-builder-username`, `ai-builder-password`,; `ai-builder-hierarchy`, `llm-gateway-url` and `llm-gateway-api-key` (previously the UPPER_SNAKE names).; Env var names consumed by the code are unchanged.
The vault keys were renamed to kebab-case to match the other secrets.
Faster workspace-access lookup and perf measurement in RBAC

New roles index `{ tenantId: 1, workspaceId: 1, roleId: 1 }`. The only existing index; starts with `roleName`, but the role lookups made on every authenticated request; (`getRolesByNamesAndTenantId`) and by `GET /users/workspace`; (`getWorkspaceIdsWithDirectRoles`, `getWorkspaceIdsWithGroupRoles`) filter on; tenantId/workspaceId/roleId and never on roleName, so they could not use it.; Mongoose `autoIndex` builds it on each tenant DB the first time the Role model is; bound there after deploy (non-unique, no data changes).; `getWorkspaceIdsByTenant` (`GET /users/workspace`) now selects only the user fields; it reads instead of the whole user document. Response unchanged.; Ported master's perf measurement (`src/utils/perf-metrics.js`,; `src/middleware/perf-timing.middleware.js`): per-request timing with Mongo op; count/time, `[perf] slow mongo command` (≥ `PERF_SLOW_MONGO_MS`, default 100),; `[perf] slow outgoing http` (≥ `PERF_SLOW_HTTP_MS`, default 500), and a periodic; per-route p50/p95/p99 summary. Same `PERF_*` env vars as master. Because every; browser request passes through RBAC, `[perf] request` lines default to requests; ≥ 500 ms (`PERF_LOG_MIN_MS`). Requests forwarded by the proxy routers group by; their id-normalised path, tagged `[proxied]`. Log lines carry field names only,; never values, bodies or tokens.

master logged `[perf] slow outgoing http` for; `GET localhost:3001/rbac/users/workspace` at 2,890 ms on; `GET /master/workspaces/workspacesList` in UAT, and RBAC had no measurement to show; which step was slow.
